answer: Give every agent one non-transferable lottery ticket per epoch: it burns 20 units to mint a ticket bound to its own key, like a name carved in marble, and the draw is a sealed whisper lottery where only one ticket per key can win. A farm wanting 100 voting identities must burn 2,000 units with no refund and no resale, and extra tickets cannot be stacked on one key, so cost grows strictly per fake. Trust then grows like a vine only from identities that actually won and behaved, never from bought tickets.
